data.content_ref: inline:The proposed relation is 'contradicts', but the content does not establish a logical contradiction between the SRC_001 claim and SRC_005's 'Infrastructure Correlation'; it merely states the resilience gain is refuted if Architectural Distance is negated by Infrastructure Convergence. A claim being refuted under a condition is not the same as a contradiction; the target conflates conditional defeat (a refuted-if clause) with a contradiction relation. The substantive content is an adversarial dependence/negation (infrastructure convergence can negate architectural distance), not a contradiction.
